skill_name: Suggest ways to reduce waste in the manufacturing industry.
workflow: The manufacturing industry can reduce waste in multiple ways. First, it can utilize digital technologies such as 3D printing and automation to reduce the amount of material and energy used during production and assembly. Additionally, motion sensors and other systems can be used to reduce energy use by automatically turning off equipment or lighting when not in use.
